title: Animal Welfare Project
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai West End extended a helping hand to Empathy Unlimited Animal Welfare Foundation by providing essential medical and comfort supplies for animals under their care.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai West End extended a helping hand to Empathy Unlimited Animal Welfare Foundation by providing essential medical and comfort supplies for animals under their care. A total of 1,000 insulin syringes (1 ml) and 418 animal bedding blankets were donated, with a total project value of ₹1,00,000. The initiative was generously sponsored by Rtn. Nikhil Rajpuria and Rtn. Deepak Agarwal. We sincerely appreciate their generosity and commitment to animal welfare and compassionate service.
